title: Son of Jailed CJNG Cell Leader 'El R-1' Breaks Silence From Hiding on Valeria Márquez Femicide Accusations
detail: Francisco Álvarez Solorio — son of Ramón Ángel Álvarez Ayala, alias 'El R-1,' the CJNG 'Los Rs' cell leader arrested July 30, 2026 in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco — gave his first public interview since going into hiding, speaking with journalist Luis Chaparro (Pie de Nota) in a video published August 21, 2026. Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch has publicly linked Álvarez Solorio to the May 13, 2025 femicide of influencer Valeria Márquez, alleging he had a romantic relationship with her, threatened her repeatedly, and asked his father to order her killing after she tried to end the relationship. In the interview, Álvarez Solorio said he feels 'a little terrified and attacked' since becoming a fugitive, described meeting Márquez in 2021 in Guadalajara nightlife, denied any role in ordering or knowing who ordered her death, and said the two had discussed reconciling before she was killed. Márquez was shot dead during a live TikTok broadcast at her Zapopan beauty salon. Álvarez Solorio remains a fugitive; no new charges were announced in connection with the interview.

confidenceReason: Interview and its content are directly verifiable (published video) and corroborated across multiple Tier 2 Mexican outlets; the underlying femicide allegation against Álvarez Solorio remains a prosecutorial claim (García Harfuch), not a court finding.
